transactions.description: Dale follows up with Lisa Freeman to confirm the two repair bids placed in tick 7 are still active and to signal continued availability for needs-based construction work in the Millfield community. The conversation is relational — not a sales pitch. Dale asks whether either property owner (leaking flat roof, retaining wall drainage failure) has made a decision, and whether Lisa knows of other deferred-maintenance situations that need a contractor. This maintains and slightly deepens the professional trust relationship.

resources.detail: No money exchanged. Trust reinforcement — Dale invests time, Lisa provides pipeline intelligence. Expected outcome: relationship trust increases marginally, potential lead on one or both repair bids.

transactions.expected_effect_on_target: Lisa Freeman receives continued evidence that Dale is reliable, community-minded, and actively seeking the kind of work that benefits her network's members (property owners who need deferred repairs done affordably by a local contractor).

transactions.description: Dale stops into Betty Kowalski's diner for coffee. Small purchase ($8), no business discussion. Purely a neighbor check-in after noticing Betty is stressed in the community. Maintains a low-trust relationship (0.45) that has potential value as a future construction referral or direct client.

resources.detail: Coffee and tip. Revenue for diner_owner.

transactions.expected_effect_on_target: Betty receives a small revenue contribution and a moment of genuine human connection during a stressful period. Trust may increase slightly.
